messages:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: High error rate detected on prod gateway (eu-west-1). 5xx spike (from 0.3% -> 12%) and TLS handshake timeouts. Paging @alex.k @priya 

alex.k: acked. I'm oncall. grabbing logs now. which svc is primary for these errors?

priya: i'm around, will join triage. do we have a region breakdown?

alex.k: traffic spike concentrated in eu-west-1, but some fallback noise in us-west-2. graphs: latency tail jumping at 03:02 UTC.

marcus: saw the alert too, logs show repeated: `TLS handshake failed: alert handshake failure` and `SSL_read: SSL_ERROR_SYSCALL` from edge-proxy workers. Also a lot of `handshake timeout after 10s`.

ops: running a quick `grep` across proxies, pulling last 30m: `grep -n "handshake" /var/log/edge-proxy/* | tail -n 50` shows many entries.

alex.k: can someone run an `openssl s_client` to check cert chain from inside the VPC?

marcus: running now from eu-west-1 bastion:
```
openssl s_client -connect gateway.prod.redwood.ai:443 -servername gateway.prod.redwood.ai -showcerts
```
Output truncated but important bit: `-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----` (leaf) then next cert is the root; MISSING intermediate. Connects fail for clients that require full chain.

priya: that would explain wide handshake failures. we rotated intermediates last night as part of CA housekeeping. did the rollout include the chain bundle?

ops: checking S3 cert-bundles bucket revision history... there was a publish at 03:01 UTC by `cert-rotator` job: `cert-bundle-eu-west-1.pem` size 2.1KB. previous version was 3.8KB. suspect trimmed intermediate.

alex.k: timeline: 03:01 cert-rotator published new bundle -> 03:02 edge-proxies picked it up (autosync) -> 03:03 handshake error ramp. makes sense.

cs_amanda: FYI customers in EU are reporting timeouts for inference requests and elevated 502s. current incident status: ~8% of active sessions affected, several enterprise customers posted support tickets.

priya: mitigation plan suggestions: 1) revert cert-bundle to previous known-good version in S3 2) trigger in-place reload on edge-proxy fleet (canary first) 3) hold cert-rotator job until postmortem. any objections?

marcus: +1. also propose temporary routing policy: route eu-west-1 traffic to healthy nodes in us-west-2 for high-tier customers while we fix.

ops: starting canary revert on 2 nodes now. commands: 
```
aws s3 cp s3://cert-bundles/cert-bundle-eu-west-1.pem~prev s3://cert-bundles/cert-bundle-eu-west-1.pem
ssh edge-proxy-eu-12 "sudo systemctl reload edge-proxy"
```

deploy-bot: deploy triggered: edge-proxy reload on edge-proxy-eu-12 by ops at 03:10 UTC (sha: reload-script-v2).

alex.k: watching metrics. canary showing immediate drop in handshake errors on those nodes. 5xx rate on canary nodes down to baseline.

ops: rolling to remaining nodes incrementally (5 at a time) with 1m pause between batches.

priya: @cs_amanda please send a short notice to impacted customers: "We're investigating a TLS certificate chain issue causing intermittent 502s/timeouts, mitigations in progress. We'll update in 30m."

cs_amanda: message posted to customer tickets and status page draft queued.

marcus: after full roll we should also revoke the bad bundle and lock the cert-rotator pipeline. I'm grabbing the exact commit that produced the truncated bundle.

ops: roll completed at 03:25 UTC. global 5xx rate back to normal. edge handshake errors down by 98%.

alex.k: confirming from traces: request success rate recovered. closing paging alerts when stable for 15m. handing incident to @priya for postmortem + RCA.

priya: taking post-incident ownership. immediate action items I'll track: [1] root cause: cert-rotator pushed bundle missing intermediate (automation bug) [2] write fix to cert-rotator to validate chain length + `openssl verify` before publish [3] add preflight canary tag so proxies don't pick up bad bundle fleet-wide automatically [4] run customer impact report and follow-up comms.

cs_amanda: I'll coordinate customer comms and compile affected orgs list.

marcus: grabbing audit log entry: `cert-rotator` v1.9.2 ran with env var `STRIP_INTERMEDIATE=true` (accidental) — pushing hotfix to rotator to disable that flag by default.

alex.k: adding retention note: incident severity SEV-2, started 03:01 UTC, mitigated 03:25 UTC, handoff to priya.

incidents-bot: Incident log updated: incident_id=INC-2026-2140001111 severity=SEV-2 owner=@priya next_update=postmortem-draft-ETA-24h

priya: thanks team. I'll open the postmortem doc and assign follow-ups. leaving channel but reachable if needed. :thumbsup:

ops: leaving a short runbook entry under `runbooks/edge-proxy/cert-rotation` to add verification step.

cs_amanda: final note: status page updated and customers notified. will attach list of impacted orgs to postmortem.

alex.k: thanks all. closing thread in 15m if stable.
